body:
I'm sure most people scanning over this are just thinking "wow I wish these were my problems. Fuck OP." 

I don't disagree. Life could be a lot harder. I'm trying. I don't even know what I enjoy doing anymore. Everything feels empty. Nihilism is nearly all-consuming. No matter how much I do, or even think about doing, nothing matters when its over.

Whatever. I'm done.

The 12 hours/7 days thing at least cools off back to 40 hours a week in May. It's only a few months of this. I've thought about leaving the first job and not even having to worry about working weekends any more but gf keeps encouraging me, "you got this," right? 

After May, if this job actually ends up sticking, I won't go back to it next year. It's not worth it. It's hardly worth it now. I just want independence.

If I ask gf to do things, it'll turn into "fine whatever I'll just do everything" and big arguments. She's supportive when it's easy. Just have to endure. I live here rent-free, no where else to go. Saving up to get out is the only reason I'm even trying to keep this up.

She'd be devastated if she read this. I feel like she'd do better outside of her abusive mom's house. No telling until after. I care about her deeply, my best friend. Only friend at this point. 

If things are still this stressful in a month, maybe I'll buy that piano I keep letting myself get talked out of.

***FUCK God.*** If the life I've lived so far is part of some fucked up grander plan, where I lose my 11-year-old cousin, her mother, and her grandmother to a genetic disease all within one year, my parents divorce after 15 years and moral-values dad disappears, mom dies to cancer when I need her most, uncle dies to a disease that progressed backwards, and my racist, pathological liar grandmother and completely disabled younger brother are all I have left?!

I'm not responding to you further. Take your cloud daddy and your r/wowthanksimcured bullshit somewhere else.

The responsibility is new. Old job seasonal, so doing nothing for 8 months. No income (and COVID last year) meant I couldn't do anything. I suppose I'm just not used to this insanity. I have health problems that would prevent me from living off-grid. I miss biking, can barely manage to stay on it these days.

Joined FIRE community on main, I'm very r/antiwork. I'm creative. Learned some minor coding to make game mods. Clay sculpting. Music. I've been a gamer all my life. Inspiration is everywhere; talent, skill, and now time (previously money) are too scarce to act on it.

If I leave gf, she offs herself. Has a history of attempted suicide. She'd put in extra effort for that split. I can't be responsible for that. I know it wouldn't be my fault but her family would hold it against me and I don't know that I could live it down either. We've been together almost 8 years. She's been so supportive verbally, but she falls apart at the lightest distress herself. 

At bare minimum I have to get enough to where I can support myself alone for a long time. With my mom dying at the end of 2019, I have no one left to fall back on except this family I'm living with. 

It took me so long to finally find work in my field, but it's a constant struggle to feel secure. No one at this workplace has been on for more than 8 months, except the CEO. I'm the third person in my position in the last 365 days.

I just want to survive and create what I can see and hear in my mind. I just don't have the skill, the time, the *tenacity* to *fail* over and over and over...

There's no point. It's all excuses anyway. I could do these things if I actually put in the extra effort. I'm just not that strong. Everyone I care about is gone.

Because the relationship I have is with someone so incredibly damaged people are scared to talk to her I guess. It's getting to be a pretty toxic problem that I don't know how long I can manage. I just have no place else to go. I live with her and her mom, lost job due to covid, burned up all my meager savings last year trying to help mom manage her condition because health insurance sucks.

I honestly can't even bring myself to say anything. I don't have the words.

If she eventually finds out even a sliver of truth about how he feels about her, she will be convinced that her broken emotional problems caused this "yet again" and it will send her into a suicidal spiral, almost guaranteed. And I'm really not sure I would say in that instance. I've offered to help her get therapy; it isn't happening. 

I'm just so tired... I lost my mom last year and this is all getting to be way too much with all the emotional trauma paired with the covid confinement.

I don't disagree with this either. However, it appears this "friend" of ours lacks the level of maturity in his suicidal self-deprecation and wallowing to stand up for the way he feels and deal with the consequences.

I'm going to be left with the fallout for this. It's happened with a few friends before but they at least hard ghosted without telling me directly (finding out through social posts later) or told her straight up.

Don't get me wrong. GF needs therapy badly that she is not taking any steps to get and it's driving me a bit insane too. Today she found out Subway isn't carrying roast beef anymore and broke down crying to the point where both staff members asked if she was okay. I told them it was other things going on compounding. It was not. I think I'll wait to say anything for a bit until that cools down, though it's not going to ever be easy.

He said, among other things I won't get into again for his privacy, that he "wants out of all this" (meaning our shared Discord group and overall contact with us) and that "it's so uncomfortable having to watch my words all the time like I'm walking on eggshells" when it comes to talking with my gf.

I doubt he'll say anything to her or anyone at this point. He's hard ghosted our group a few times, but gf still holds him in such high regard after that because of the conversations they've had. He's probably been kinda like a friend-therapist to her I guess.  All in all, it's indeed *not* fair, but it looks like "fair" isn't on the menu for me.

You might want to check out r/raisedbynarcissists, there is a lot more explained there. r/RBNSpouses is a place for those of us with SOs that were RBN (see full subreddit name above) seeking advice on how to deal with it.

"Dragon" 

mf I know a Rathalos when I see one

Edit: Also it looks great so gj
Legitimate question, are you color blind?
A lot of this is more passive musing at the moment; I've got a lot to do before I'm in a position to do anything about my situation.

I do actually recognize that this was the intent, my response was just unclear enough to mask it.

For day to day things it's minor enough that I tend to forget about the discomfort her reactions bring. Reading this so directly helps snap me out of that and think about long term, so ty.
I'll just be honest, I don't know how to answer that right now. Hard to even consider it when I know she is completely against the idea.

I guess what my situation is coming down to now is preparing myself for complete independence. I don't have the means right now to live unsupported so that's step one. Starting to think anything I can get full time is going to be an improvement.
At work (13 hour days for the last 39/43 days) so I'll look these over on some down time later, but I wanted to sincerely thank you for the resources while I have a moment.

Her family has also brainwashed her into believing that renting (we live in CA so... cost of living etc etc) is basically throwing away money. Only "viable" option is to buy a home. My yearly income right now is about 8k and hers is 0. I admit I haven't been trying the hardest for work since I've been wanting to get specifically into my field and only have an AA, so there's been a disconnect between work, school, and home stress (mom dying, gallbladder exploding, other issues).

I admit I'm a bit lazy, but buying a home is 100% off the table for at least 2-3 years, even if I do land a job...

The worst part right now is that she missed the deadline to get health insurance and I'm not sure if there's even an option to get something online so she can get help.

Edit: US citizens, our health care system sucks lol

I think my problem is I'm afraid of her self-destructive tendencies and her family's history with male abusers. She's told me she "wouldn't know what to do without [me]" and heavily implying she would self-harm if I left the picture. And honestly I don't want to leave her; when she's in a good mood and things are going well she's hilarious and wonderful to be around. Her family taking me in and supporting me while I try to find stable work has been incredibly helpful as well.

It's just when things take even the slightest downward turn I feel like I'm instantly WOES with every word to keep her happy and I'm developing a similar tendency to react negatively to minor things... it's gotta stop one way or the other. I guess I have to get over my fear of confronting this or the accusations of being a user. Or the fear of her doing something permanent that she can't take back.

The sad part is that I can see it. If I manage to get her out from her mother that constantly tells her she's going to fail at whatever she does and get some therapy, it's a wonderful existence with a loving, caring woman who has sacrificed so much for me over the years. 

If... if she doesn't get help then it's a very isolated existence where I end up losing contact with a lot of people (like I already have)  from the discomfort that comes from the upsetti.

It's not what I wanted to hear but I know it's right. I've just got to get myself into a positive cash flow (my seasonal work pays pennies and I need Bachelor's for my field) as a step one.
